title: Rainmaker, Ep 1: Attempt 41
logline: In 2099 Rajasthan, where a company sells every drop of water, a 13-year-old girl builds a machine from scrap that makes it rain, and the company notices.
trend_basis: A 'world after' science-fiction short was the biggest English-language hit in this week's scan (3.0M views), from a single video
Poor-family-changes-its-fate stories recur among the top Hindi results (1.1M, 535K)
Episode numbering appears in 22% of short videos
original_twist: Indian village science fiction with no chosen one and no aliens: the hero is a scrapyard kid, the villain is a water bill, and every episode her rain costs the village something.

series.title: Rainmaker
series.season_arc: Tara's machine makes her village the first place in decades with free water, and the company that owns the rain comes to take it back.
series.cliffhanger: Company tanker drones turn toward the village while Tara refuses to hide the machine.

characters.voice: Clear, quick young girl's voice with dry humour

story.opening_hook: A single drop of water hits cracked earth and a dozen hands reach for it.
hook_variants: Open on Tara laughing in pouring rain, freeze, then text: 'This rain is illegal.'
Open on the black tanker drones turning toward the village, then cut to: 'Three minutes earlier.'

acts.name: World
acts.summary: Dadu is refused water; Tara is building a machine and says she is making water, not stealing it.

acts.name: Attempt
acts.summary: Attempt 41: the beam goes up and the sky stays empty.

acts.name: Rain
acts.summary: A cloud blooms, and the village gets its first rain.

acts.name: Price
acts.summary: Company drones turn toward the village.

story.ending: Dadu begs Tara to hide the machine as the drones close in; she stands in the rain and stares at them.
